info.title: Policy_Action_Set
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

properties.description:
Reference Resource: [Policy_Action_Set](#/Policy_Action_Set)
The group of actions associated with this policy entry. The actions group is applied to each entry of the associated class.The actions group specified in this policy entry is defined in [Policy_Actions] (Policy_Actions) An empty column value indicates that no match criteria is specified for this list.

acl_drop.description: Drop packets matching the criteria specified in an associated class entry. If drop is specified, then all other actions will be ignored.

cbs.description: Set the Committed Burst Size for matching packets. Associated with cir An empty column value indicates that this action will not be taken on matched packets.

cir.description: Set the Committed Information Rate for matching packets. An empty column value indicates that this action will not be taken on matched packets.

dscp.description: Set the Differentiated Services Code Point value of matching IPv4 and IPv6 packets to the specified value. An empty column value indicates that this action will not be taken on matched packets.

ecn.description: Set the Explicit Congestion Notification value of matching IPv4 and IPv6 packets to the specified value. An empty column value indicates that this action will not be taken on matched packets.

ip_precedence.description: Set the ip-precedence value. An empty column value indicates that this action will not be taken on matched packets.

local_priority.description: Set the local priority of matching packets to the specified value. An empty column value indicates that this action will not be taken on matched packets.

mirror.description: Set the mirroring action for matching packets. A maximum of 4 mirror sessions can be specified in one action set. An empty column value indicates that this action will not be taken on matched packets.

origin.description: Origin of the Policy_Action_Set, i.e., how the Policy_Action_Set is provisioned:  `synthesized`: Policy_Action_Set has been dynamically synthesized                 by the system.  `static`     : Policy_Action_Set is provisioned by the administrator                 via CLI or REST.

pbr_action_list.description:
Reference Resource: [PBR_Action_List](#/PBR_Action_List)
Set the PBR Action List for matching packets. An empty column value indicates that this action will not be taken on matched packets.

pcp.description: Set the priority code point value of matching packets to the specified value. An empty column value indicates that this action will not be taken on matched packets.

parameters.name: Policy.name
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [Policy](#/Policy)
Name of a Classifier Policy (Policy).

parameters.name: Policy_Entry.sequence_number
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [Policy_Entry](#/Policy_Entry)
Policy entries as configured by the user. For a child Policy, the configured Policy entries are located in the parent Policy and this value is ignored. An empty column value indicates that no match criteria is specified for this list.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
